BOKU
UNIVERSITY

The Department of Biotechnology and Food Science, Institute of Computational Biology is

currently seeking a 1 Postdoctoral Research Associate (Reference code 204)

Extent of employment: 40 hours per week

Duration of employment: 1st of March 2027, limited to 30th of September 2029

Workplace: 1190 Vienna

Allocation in compliance with the Collective Agreement for University Staff to job group:

B1 lit. b

Gross monthly salary: (depending on previous eligible experience) at least: € 5.079,50

(payable 14 times per year)

Responsibilities

º Scientific research in bioinformatics, genomics, and evolution of crop plants and their

wild relatives, supporting and extending current research lines of the Institute of

Computational Biology

º Preparation of scientific publications, presentations at conferences and seminars

º Participation in grant writing

º Supporting the group's computing infrastructure, databases, and services

º Teaching activities in English and/or German

Required skills and qualifications

º Doctorate degree with scientific focus on genome bioinformatics/computational

biology

º Language skills: English B2

º Experience in analyzing and interpreting large-scale genomic data sets from

eukaryotes, related to high- throughput sequencing, genotyping, and structural

variation discovery

º Proficiency with working on high-performance computing systems (Linux command

line, bash scripting)

º Solid programming and scripting skills (Python and/or Perl and/or R, but not exclusively

R)

º Excellent publication record

º Strong motivation and dedication, scientific writing skills, problem-solving skills

Desirable skills and qualifications

º Experience with crop plant genomics

º Experience with machine-learning applications in genomics

º Postdoctoral experience

º Wet-lab experience

º Teaching experience, supervision of students' projects

º German language skills are advantageous but not essential

What we offer

º Postdoc position in a friendly, interdisciplinary team with access to comprehensive

data sets (resequencing data, reference assemblies, genotyping data of crop plants)

º Strong computational resources: in-house Linux-Cluster with high-performance CPU

and GPU servers, access to Austrian national computing infrastructure

Applications can be submitted until: 15th of December 2026

BOKU University seeks to increase the number of its female faculty and staff members.

Therefore qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply. In case of equal qualification,

female candidates will be given preference unless reasons specific to an individual male

candidate tilt the balance in his favour.

People with disabilities and appropriate qualifications are specifically encouraged to apply.

Please send your job application incl.

º Motivation letter

º CV

º Contact details of 3 referees

º All application documents combined in a single pdf (max. 1 MB)

to HR Management, BOKU University, Peter-Jordan-Straße 70, 1190 Vienna;

E-Mail: recruiting@boku.ac.at. (Reference code: 204)

We regret that we cannot reimburse applicants travel and lodging expenses incurred as part of

the selection and hiring process.

Join one of the fastest-growing companies! ¿ 1 Procurement Manager (f/m/d) The Role

As our first Procurement Manager, you own the cash fonio spends with third parties. You build procurement from zero, on your own: processes, tools, cost control and our vendor relationships. You work closely with IT and Finance, and you have the autonomy to decide within agreed limits.

What to Expect

 * Build the procurement function from scratch: source-to-pay process, procurement policy, approval thresholds and buying playbooks

 * Select and implement the right tools for intake, purchase orders, contracts and SaaS management, and connect them to our accounting together with Finance

 * Control expenses: full visibility over spend by vendor, team and category, a renewal calendar with no unchecked auto-renewals, and measurable savings

 * Own vendor management: sourcing, RFPs and negotiations for cloud, telephony and carriers, AI/LLM providers, SaaS, hardware and services

 * Run vendor onboarding, due diligence, performance reviews and risk checks (GDPR, DPAs, security)

 * Work with IT on the full software and hardware lifecycle: request, security review, provisioning, license tracking and offboarding

What You Bring

 * several years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing or vendor management, ideally in a tech scale-up

 * You have built or significantly scaled a procurement process before, and you work fully independently

 * Strong negotiator with a track record of measurable savings

 * Hands-on experience implementing procurement or spend-management tools

 * Solid understanding of SaaS, cloud and IT purchasing; telephony or AI/LLM vendors are a plus

 * Pragmatism: you keep processes simple, so buying gets faster, not slower

 * Tech oriented: you are obsessed with efficiency and make sure that our systems are connected and automate our expenses

 * Fluent English

Nice-to-haves

 * German is a plus

 * Experience with different markets across Europe, US & Brazil

What We Offer

 * €70,000 to €80,000

 * Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

 

Hiring Process

 * 20 min Intro Call with Talent Acquisition

 * 30 min Skill Interview (Deep dive on your technical skills of the role through a case)

 * 20 min Cultural Fit

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

We ship new features every week, and our sales team is growing across several markets. As Sales Enablement Manager, you make sure every seller knows what they're selling, who to sell it to and how to win the deal.

You'll train, coach and run role plays, and you'll connect Product and Sales. Your goal is to get new AEs to target faster and help the whole team win more, and bigger, deals.

What you'll do

 * Run weekly sales enablement sessions, including role plays, deal reviews and live practice.

 * Capture what our best AEs do differently and turn it into repeatable playbooks for the team.

 * Own AE onboarding and make it faster, so new hires reach their targets sooner.

 * Keep sales up to date on every product release. Explain what changed, who it's for and how to pitch it.

 * Create the material sellers actually use: pitch decks, talk tracks, objection handling and battlecards.

 * Act as the link between Product and Sales. Bring product updates to the team and bring field feedback back to Product.

 * Coach AEs one-to-one on calls and deals.

 * Track and improve the numbers: ramp time for new AEs, win rate and average contract value.

What you bring

 * You have experience in sales enablement, sales training or a similar role at a B2B SaaS company.

 * You have a sales background, ideally as an AE, so sellers respect what you teach.

 * You know sales methodology well and can turn it into practical, hands-on training.

 * You're comfortable leading a room and getting people to practise, not just listen.

 * You can take a complex product update and explain it clearly in minutes.

 * You're analytical and use data to see what's working and what isn't.

 * You're fluent in English. Spanish or other European languages are a plus.

Nice to have

 * Experience in a fast-shipping product environment, where the pitch changes every week.

 * Experience selling to SMBs or in a high-velocity sales environment.

 * Experience building an onboarding program from scratch.

What you get

 * High visibility. Your work shows up directly in revenue.

 * Close work with the CCO, the sales team and Product.

 * A team of ambitious people, many of them former founders.

 * Salary: €80000 - €110000.

Process

 * Intro Call (30 mins)

 * Skill Interview (60 mins)

 * Interview with CCO (30 mins)

 * Culture Call (20 mins)
